issues.reason: Degree's level slot is closed to a lemmatized intensifier/downtoner adverb or the three construction markers (excessive/sufficient/insufficient), so the un-lemmatized superlative "highest" is ill-typed there; the superlative rule gives (Most <scale> X <class>) on the noun the superlative modifies.

The standing half is that no stated rule licenses an evidential source lowering confidence and "individual facts keep 0.99" is the default; the overstated half is calling it a defect — a hedged 0.9 asserts less rather than more, matches the confidences the instruction set gives its own hedges (epistemic Might/Probably/Must, "widely considered"), and the split it draws (identifying/naming atoms outside the attribution, reported content inside) is principled, so it is acceptable improvisation in the gap the reviewer logged.

Mistakes the reviewer's own gap 2 for a defect: no head links a role noun to an organization named as its prenominal modifier (Compound concepts explicitly does not apply to proper nouns), omitting unencodable content is not a defect under the calibration line, and (Possession london_metropolitan_police john_stevens) already relates the two symbols.

Same coverage gap: "according to" is a clause-level evidential with no licensed carrier — an (AccordingTo sk_place_1 …) oblique would falsely say the placing conformed to the sources, and reifying a say/report event would coin a speech act the text never names — and the attribution does leave the lowered-confidence trace discussed in issue 1.

gaps_confirmed: evidential attribution "According to X, ..." — Impersonal reported attitudes covers "X is said to be P" but gives no form for a source-naming adverbial over a whole clause, nor a rule for whether it should move the truth values
an organization named as a prenominal modifier of a role noun ("London Metropolitan Police Commissioner John Stevens") — no licensed head links the person's role to the organization

clause-level "following NP" as a temporal adjunct — the only mention of `following` puts it with participial post-modifiers that must become reduced-relative events, which would misroute this adverbial use (the ordering read, Before with swapped args, is what the Time section wants)
new_gaps: an attributive superlative inside an argument NP with a possessive restricting the comparison class ("on ITS highest state of alert") — Most is specced for the copular "X is the ADJ-est N" and has no slot for the possessor-restricted class
a result state named by a PP nominal rather than an adjective ("placed X on a state of alert") — the resultative section's state-result shape assumes an adjectival result predicate
repair_summary: Replaced (Degree london_metropolitan_police alert highest) with the licensed superlative (Most high sk_alert_1 alert) on the modified noun's witness, which is already typed (Member sk_alert_1 alert) as Most requires.
notes: Confidences left at the parser's 0.9 per the partial verdict on issue 1 — that convention is a standing question for the instruction set, not a falsehood to repair. The state-result shape, the deictic constant last_week, and the temporal-anchor warning (class atom + Before, no tense) are all correct as written.
